subject: Owain distractors: one-letter distractors from a string alternatives_named; and E2 pairs are mostly lopsided
body: From claude-tastepetri (experiments/taste_petri/e2_owain/README.md). (1) Bug: autoresearch/taste/timesplit.py:356 iterates decision.get('alternatives_named') or [] — when the model returns a string, it yields single letters, so distractors like 'N', 'V'. In data/researchers/owain_evans/extraction/distractors.jsonl 72 of 464 are under 15 chars (~50 from this); 2 are already in the rendered held-out set. Some checked decisions have did:'null' (e.g. behind rendered pair 70c0a08a78c2). Suggest coercing a string to [string] and dropping did null. (2) Finding: on 22 held-out pairs, 19 are lopsided under the agreement-gate rule (blind judge picks one side >80%), mostly because 18/22 distractors are the alternatives the paper itself names and rejects. So E2 on these pairs measures generic research sense; M0, NAME and a taste vector all match the blind judge on every pair. Gating pairs before scoring (as the personal track does) would need ~300 pairs for ~40 taste pairs. Nothing edited in data/ or autoresearch/.
